subject: agent-governance-toolkit
positioning: Runtime governance for AI agents — deterministic policy enforcement, zero-trust identity, execution sandboxing, Agent SRE. Maintained by Microsoft.

language_stack.runtime: Library / middleware / sidecar — no platform UI

differentiators_observable: OWASP Agentic Top 10 — 10/10 covered com mapping por ASI-ID (README table)
Policy engine deterministico < 0.1ms por acao (BENCHMARKS.md reclamado)
9,500+ tests declarados, CI via GitHub Actions, OpenSSF Scorecard badge
Zero-trust identity: Ed25519 + quantum-safe ML-DSA-65, trust scoring 0-1000, SPIFFE/SVID
Execution sandboxing com 4-tier privilege rings, saga orchestration, kill switch
Agent SRE: SLOs, error budgets, replay debugging, chaos engineering, circuit breakers
Shadow AI Discovery para achar agentes nao registrados
MCP Security Scanner (tool poisoning, typosquatting, hidden instructions)
Unified CLI 'agt' — agt verify, agt doctor, agt lint-policy
Agent Marketplace package para plugin lifecycle management
Integracoes: Microsoft Agent Framework (native), Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, LangGraph/LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents, Google ADK, LlamaIndex, Haystack, Dify (plugin)
Compliance mapping: EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, SOC 2, Colorado AI Act
Public Preview — Microsoft-signed releases, may break before GA
